town_description: Varanasi (Banaras/Kashi) is one of the world's oldest living cities, on the banks of the Ganga in eastern Uttar Pradesh. India's spiritual capital, it is famed for the Kashi Vishwanath Temple, its ghats, Banaras Hindu University, and silk weaving.
